title_zh: 把问卷结论限制在受访者范围内

scenario.goal_zh: 核对样本、局限与结论的依据

context_zh: 研究小组讨论一份社区设施问卷，识别样本局限并修改结论。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Tara
sentences.text: Can you help me analyse the responses before I send the report?

sentences.speaker: Joel
sentences.text: Of course. Your opening claim is that most residents support closing the car park.

sentences.speaker: Tara
sentences.text: That was my belief after reading the comments. Nearly all of them were positive.

sentences.speaker: Joel
sentences.text: How many people answered, and where did we find them?

sentences.speaker: Tara
sentences.text: Thirty-two. We handed out the survey at the cycling club.

sentences.speaker: Joel
sentences.text: Then that is not a sound basis for a conclusion about the whole town.

sentences.speaker: Tara
sentences.text: You are right. The analysis only tells us about the people who replied.

sentences.speaker: Joel
sentences.text: Exactly. Their attitude to the plan matters, but other residents may think differently.

sentences.speaker: Tara
sentences.text: I will change the opening to say that twenty-eight of the thirty-two respondents supported it.

sentences.speaker: Joel
sentences.text: And explain how we recruited them. Then readers can judge the limits for themselves.

sentences.speaker: Tara
sentences.text: I will add that beside the result and remove the town-wide claim.
